newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean feed firms buy 52,500T of corn - official.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean feed firms buy 52,500T of corn - official.

text.p: A group of South Korean feed milling companies bought 52,500 tonnes of corn on Tuesday but passed on a tender for another 52,500 tonnes, an official at one of the companies said.
Earlier, traders in Seoul said the group bought 50,000 tonnes but passed on a tender for another 52,500 tonnes due to high prices.
The official said the group had invited tenders to buy a position of 50,000 tonnes and another of 52,500 tonnes, but later increased the first position to 52,500 tonnes.
He said the group bought the corn from Tradigrain at $133.95 a tonne C&F for part of the amount and $0.728 per bushel over May futures on the Chicago Board of Trade for the remainder.
But he could not give more details on pricing.
He said the seller could deliver the corn from worldwide origins, but price would be cut by $5 per tonne if from China.
The official said the group included Cheiljedang Corp, Miwon Co Ltd, Woo Sung Feed Mill Co Ltd and Purina Korea Inc.
Traders said the lowest offer price for the passed tender was between $136.50 to $137.30 a tonne C&F by Cargill.
